title: Прикметники на -ed і -ing
explanation:
**-ed** — почуття: *I'm / I feel / I got + bored*
**-ing** — причина: *it's / the film is / he's + boring*

Правопис: *annoy → annoyed / annoying*, *terrify → terrified / terrifying*, *embarrass → embarrassed / embarrassing*.
Прийменники після -ed: *interested **in***, *excited / worried / embarrassed **about***, *tired **of***, *bored **with***, *surprised **at / by***, *disappointed **with / by***.
Підсилення: *very bored, very boring* — але *absolutely exhausted, really amazing* (не ~~very amazing~~).

guide.idea: Пара bored / boring — це «хто відчуває» і «що викликає». -ed — про почуття людини, -ing — про людину, річ чи ситуацію, що це почуття спричиняє. Переплутаєте — і «мені нудно» стане «я нудний».

use.note: -ed — стан людини: I'm, I feel, I got + -ed.
use.en: I'm so tired after the flight.

use.note: -ing про людину — як вона впливає на інших.
use.en: Our new neighbour is really annoying.

use.note: -ed + прийменник: interested in, worried about, tired of.
use.en: Sophie is worried about her exam.

mistakes.wrong: It was a very amazing trip.
mistakes.right: It was an absolutely amazing trip.
mistakes.why: Сильні прикметники (amazing, exhausted) не підсилюємо very — кажемо absolutely, really.
«Набридло» — tired of; tired from — утомився фізично від чогось.

formula: річ / ситуація викликає почуття → **-ing**: *The trip was tiring.*

head: Почуття (-ed)
Причина (-ing)
Приклад
rows: I was bored because the lecture was boring.
It was a tiring day, so we're really tired.
I felt embarrassed — it was so embarrassing!
The noise is annoying. I'm getting annoyed.
This tax form is confusing. I'm confused.
The hotel was disappointing. We were disappointed.

examples.en: Emma was really excited about our trip to Portugal.
examples.uk: Емма з нетерпінням чекала нашої поїздки до Португалії.

examples.en: Moving to a new country can be exhausting.
examples.uk: Переїзд до нової країни може бути виснажливим.

examples.en: I'm not interested in football, to be honest.
examples.uk: Чесно кажучи, мене не цікавить футбол.

examples.en: It's worrying that prices keep going up.
We were amazed by the view from the top.
I'm tired of waiting for the landlord to fix the heating.
examples.uk: Мені набридло чекати, поки орендодавець полагодить опалення.

tip: Перевірка: можна сказати «**мені** …»? Тоді **-ed**: *мені нудно* → *I'm **bored***. Скажете *I'm boring* — це «я нудний».

exercises.prompt: The film was so ___ that I fell asleep.
I was really ___ when I forgot his name at the party.
Are you ___ in coming to the concert with us?
The instructions for this coffee machine are really ___.
We were ___ with the service at that restaurant.
After a ___ (relax) weekend in the Lake District, we felt great.
Emma is ___ (excite) about her new job.
I'm ___ (tire) of eating pasta every day.

exercises.sentence: I'm so boring — there's nothing to do here.
The news was very surprised for everyone.

exercises.prompt: The museum interested us a lot.
answer: We were very interested in the museum.
We were really interested in the museum.
We were interested in the museum.
